mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 64 degrees and clear at Verona City Hall. We also have a Waxing Gibbous moon, and if you look to the northwest over Verona High School at 5:49 PM, you can watch the International Space Station pass by for three minutes as it travels toward Madison.

The city has released important Thanksgiving reminders, noting that city offices and the recycling center will be closed on November 26 and 27, and refuse pickup will be delayed. Additionally, the city is moving forward with a new Public Works facility project to accommodate our growing population.

There is plenty to enjoy in town, including live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow. Also, keep an eye out for upcoming yoga sessions on Sunday and trivia nights next week.
In a recent report, on November 2, officers were dispatched to West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
You can grab a scoop of Crazy for Cookie Dough today, as the store is open until 10:30 PM, so make sure to stop by soon.
